items.details: Use a tranquilizer or suitable CQC to incapacitate the soldier, then drag him back to the truck and complete the recovery interaction. This is ground transport, not Peace Walker's Fulton system. Clear a safe path first: dragging is slow and leaves you exposed. A captured ordinary enemy may remain a prisoner before joining, so inspect the management tabs rather than expecting immediate field availability. Suitable support careers can improve recovery and conversion later.

details_i18n.pt: Use tranquilizantes ou CQC adequado para incapacitar o soldado; depois arraste-o ao caminhão e conclua a recuperação. É transporte terrestre, não o Fulton de Peace Walker. Um inimigo comum capturado pode continuar como prisioneiro antes de se juntar ao grupo; confira as abas de gestão em vez de esperar disponibilidade imediata em campo. items.title: Defeat Python
items.description: Finish the boss encounter; inspect Details beforehand if recruiting Python is part of your optional goals.

items.details: To recruit Python, deplete his stamina with the Mk22 or another suitable nonlethal weapon rather than emptying his life bar. Keep moving around the arena and maintain enough distance to avoid contact with his suit. Do not waste shots into the nitrogen discharge. If a weapon freezes, retreat and allow it to recover instead of trying to fire continuously. Bring healing before entering: choosing the nonlethal outcome changes the recruitment result, but does not make his attacks harmless.

details_i18n.en: To recruit Python, deplete his stamina with the Mk22 or another suitable nonlethal weapon rather than emptying his life bar. Keep moving around the arena and maintain enough distance to avoid contact with his suit. Do not waste shots into the nitrogen discharge. If a weapon freezes, retreat and allow it to recover instead of trying to fire continuously. Bring healing before entering: choosing the nonlethal outcome changes the recruitment result, but does not make his attacks harmless.
details_i18n.pt: Para recrutar Python, esgote o vigor com Mk22 ou outra arma não letal adequada em vez de zerar a vida. Continue se movendo pela arena e mantenha distância suficiente para evitar contato com o traje. Não desperdice disparos na descarga de nitrogênio. Se a arma congelar, recue e espere a recuperação em vez de tentar disparar continuamente. Leve cura antes de entrar: escolher o desfecho não letal muda o recrutamento, mas não torna os ataques inofensivos.

items.details: Null blocks ordinary frontal shots while defending. Keep distance and use cover or lateral movement through his firing sequence, then shoot during the reload opening. A brief side or rear opening while he runs can also work. Do not empty magazines into his raised weapon or rush into machete range after one successful hit. Use the Mk22 or Mosin-Nagant if pursuing stamina damage. The second encounter follows the same basic timing, so retain a loadout you can control reliably.

details_i18n.en: Null blocks ordinary frontal shots while defending. Keep distance and use cover or lateral movement through his firing sequence, then shoot during the reload opening. A brief side or rear opening while he runs can also work. Do not empty magazines into his raised weapon or rush into machete range after one successful hit. Use the Mk22 or Mosin-Nagant if pursuing stamina damage. The second encounter follows the same basic timing, so retain a loadout you can control reliably.
details_i18n.pt: Null bloqueia disparos frontais comuns enquanto se defende. Mantenha distância e use cobertura ou movimento lateral durante a sequência de tiros; ataque na abertura da recarga. Uma abertura lateral ou pelas costas enquanto corre também pode funcionar. Não esvazie carregadores contra a arma erguida nem entre no alcance do facão após acertar um golpe. Use Mk22 ou Mosin-Nagant para causar dano ao vigor. O segundo encontro segue o mesmo ritmo básico; mantenha um conjunto que você controle bem.

items.details: Bring the RPG-7 and enough healing before entering the Plant sequence. In the ground phase, target all four legs instead of spending rockets on closed weapon compartments. After the machine changes phase, wait for its missile launchers to open and strike the exposed compartments. Keep ammunition for both sides and evade the missile barrages between openings. A suitable automatic weapon helps when a clean rocket shot is unavailable; standing close to thrusters or beneath a descending machine is dangerous.

details_i18n.en: Bring the RPG-7 and enough healing before entering the Plant sequence. In the ground phase, target all four legs instead of spending rockets on closed weapon compartments. After the machine changes phase, wait for its missile launchers to open and strike the exposed compartments. Keep ammunition for both sides and evade the missile barrages between openings. A suitable automatic weapon helps when a clean rocket shot is unavailable; standing close to thrusters or beneath a descending machine is dangerous.
details_i18n.pt: Leve RPG-7 e cura suficiente antes da sequência da Fábrica. Na fase terrestre, mire nas quatro pernas em vez de gastar foguetes em compartimentos fechados. Quando a máquina mudar de fase, espere os lançadores abrirem e ataque os compartimentos expostos. Reserve munição para os dois lados e evite as barragens de mísseis entre as aberturas. Uma arma automática adequada ajuda quando não há um tiro limpo de foguete; ficar perto dos propulsores ou sob a máquina descendo é perigoso.

items.title: Defeat Gene
items.description: Read his attack cues and use deliberate recovery windows; Details explains the unusual defensive and pressure mechanics.

description_i18n.en: Read his attack cues and use deliberate recovery windows; Details explains the unusual defensive and pressure mechanics.

items.details: Gene avoids many shots while freely moving, so attack in his recovery windows rather than spraying continuously. Evade the glowing rush sideways, then punish the pause afterward. The moment after a knife sequence or an exposed back during movement also offers an opening. His voice-based pressure can be interrupted with a stun grenade; use that space to regain control and heal if necessary. Keep a dependable weapon ready and avoid sacrificing your remaining health for one speculative shot.

details_i18n.en: Gene avoids many shots while freely moving, so attack in his recovery windows rather than spraying continuously. Evade the glowing rush sideways, then punish the pause afterward. The moment after a knife sequence or an exposed back during movement also offers an opening. His voice-based pressure can be interrupted with a stun grenade; use that space to regain control and heal if necessary. Keep a dependable weapon ready and avoid sacrificing your remaining health for one speculative shot.
details_i18n.pt: Gene evita muitos disparos enquanto se move livremente; ataque nas recuperações em vez de atirar sem parar. Desvie lateralmente da investida luminosa e aproveite a pausa seguinte. O instante após uma sequência de facas ou as costas expostas durante o movimento também oferecem aberturas. Uma granada de atordoamento pode interromper a pressão pela voz; use esse espaço para recuperar o controle e curar-se se necessário. Mantenha uma arma confiável pronta e não arrisque a vida restante em um disparo incerto.

items.details: Preserve the Airport's suited official for the optional contact chain: interrogate rather than recruit him during the earlier story visit. After recruiting Sokolov, deploy spies in Town, Western Wilderness and Guest House. Follow the Silo Entrance officer's lead, the nighttime Town contact and the Airport interrogation to obtain 141.23. Continue the Guest House and Western Wilderness reports, then inspect the Security Base locker clue. Contact EVA at the Communications Base, follow the stated waiting period and investigate the resulting Airport and Western Wilderness rescue reports.

After recruiting Sokolov, deploy spies in Town, Western Wilderness and Guest House. Follow the Silo Entrance officer's lead, the nighttime Town contact and the Airport interrogation to obtain 141.23. Continue the Guest House and Western Wilderness reports, then inspect the Security Base locker clue. details_i18n.pt: Preserve o oficial de terno do Aeroporto para a sequência opcional: interrogue-o em vez de recrutá-lo na visita anterior da história. Siga a pista do oficial da Entrada do Silo, o contato noturno na Cidade e o interrogatório no Aeroporto para obter 141.23. Continue os relatórios da Casa de Hóspedes e de Western Wilderness e examine a pista no armário da Base de Segurança. Contate EVA na Base de Comunicações, cumpra a espera indicada e investigue os relatórios resultantes do Aeroporto e do resgate em Western Wilderness.
